subject.title: boot-md hook re-runs BOOT.md on every gateway restart

question: Should boot-md remain a per-gateway-startup checklist, or should BOOT.md become a first-run/run-once initializer with an explicit reset path?
rationale: Current docs and tests define per-startup behavior, while the issue asks to change that lifecycle and add persistent state, so automation should not choose the product contract or state owner by itself.

options.title: Preserve Per-Startup Default
options.body: Keep BOOT.md as a documented startup checklist and document idempotent BOOT.md patterns or hook disablement for users who need one-time initialization.

options.title: Adopt Run-Once Lifecycle
options.body: Change boot-md to record canonical completion state with an explicit reset or doctor path, then update docs and tests around the new lifecycle.

options.title: Add Explicit Mode Later
options.body: Keep the current default but design a separate opt-in run-once mode only after maintainers agree on the config or state surface.

recommendation.title: Preserve Per-Startup Default
recommendation.body: Keep BOOT.md as a documented startup checklist and document idempotent BOOT.md patterns or hook disablement for users who need one-time initialization.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the boot-md startup hook and are the strongest history signal for the lifecycle contract.
